speaker: Patient
text: On review, there's no history of cough, fever, vomiting, or diarrhea. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is helpful; since you have no respiratory infection, the rapid breathing is likely due to poor cardiac output or fluid overload. Do you notice any swelling in your hands or face, or do you wake up feeling short of breath at night?

REQUEST TEST: Echocardiogram.
REQUEST IMAGES: Chest_XRay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Echocardiogram: Presence of an atrial septal defect with left to right shunt. Chest_XRay: Enlarged cardiac silhouette, no pulmonary edema.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Atrial Septal Defect leading to right-sided heart failure with systemic venous congestion.
